english: If this Pokémon isn't Confused, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果这只宝可梦未处于'''混乱'''状态的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has no damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果对手的战斗宝可梦身上没有放置伤害指示物的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If this Pokémon has 4 or more damage counters on it, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果这只宝可梦身上放置有4个及以上伤害指示物的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't Burned, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果对手的战斗宝可梦未处于'''{{TCG|灼伤}}'''状态的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If you don't have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果自己的手牌与对手的手牌张数不同的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If there is no Stadium in play, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果场上没有竞技场的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If your opponent doesn't have exactly 3 or 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果对手的剩余奖赏卡张数不为4张、3张的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If this Pokémon evolved during this turn, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 在这个回合，如果这只宝可梦刚完成进化的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If this Pokémon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 在这个回合，如果这只宝可梦没有从备战区被放于战斗场上的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If you don't have exactly 3 cards in your hand, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果自己的手牌数量不为3张的话，则这个招式失败。

english: If you don't have {{TCG|Uxie}} and {{TCG|Azelf}} on your Bench, this attack does nothing.
chinese: 如果自己的备战区中没有「由克希」「亚克诺姆」的话，则这个招式失败。
